# Description

This document outlines the core design specifications and structural guidelines for the Tiramis-u, Inc. ERP web application. It establishes the foundational design tokens, typography scales, module color systems, and dark-mode operational patterns built for our enterprise dashboard suite.

**File & Assets**

- **UI Blueprint & Repository:** https://www.figma.com/design/O1EsT9in4dEaMgsvskkPuj/SOFT-ENGR-GRP?node-id=0-1&t=2N9ne13x5pPuFGfe-1
- **Main View Panels:** Landing Page, Authentication Modals (Sign in, Register, Password Reset), and User Dashboard
